description.translate: Garrick knows his metals. I need twelve copper ingots to restore the fittings on my instrument bench. Before we trust another reading, we must trust the apparatus. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

Now we can compare signals instead of chasing echoes. The Ranker trapped a Warden's call in Tears for Fears. I helped measure that resonance. Every success sent him after another ability; the instruments he promised to repair kept waiting.
